summary: A short single-column page for a free coding font in Solarized Light colours: name, tagline and two buttons, then four pilcrow-separated rows pairing a small specimen (code, boxed 'monospace', high/low, |1lI B8 CD0O) with a note that opens with an ASCII-art drop cap, a tip-jar line and the full character set. Everything is set in mononoki itself.

instances.look: Lowercase 'mononoki' in Solarized orange, centred at ~96px, an italic tagline 'a font for programming and code review' beneath, and two small outlined green buttons '→ View on GitHub' and '→ Download' far apart on one row
instances.feel: Quiet, warm, like a light editor theme
instances.ux: Buttons link to the GitHub repo and directly to the release ZIP
instances.learn: Borrow a well-known editor colour scheme (Solarized) for the whole page: coders recognise the setting their font will live in

reconstruction.layout: Centred 1000px column (x 220–1220) on a #fdf6e3 page with #eee8d5 side margins; name centred at y≈60–130; tagline ~30px below; buttons at x≈390 and x≈910, y≈265
reconstruction.typography: Name ~96px mononoki Regular lowercase, #cb4b16-ish orange; tagline ~20px mononoki Italic, orange; buttons ~14px Regular green with 1px green border, '→' prefix
reconstruction.content: Name, one-line purpose, GitHub and Download

instances.look: Four rows separated by a grey '¶': left a small specimen (highlighted Python FizzBuzz 'mono'/'noki', the word 'monospace' with each letter in its own dark cell, 'high' / 'low' with italic 'works well on … resolution displays', and '|1lI B8 CD0O' under 'differentiation of characters'), right a short paragraph whose first letter is a 4-line ASCII-art drop cap (M, T, R, E) drawn with | \ / _ in orange
instances.ux: static; pilcrows act as section anchors (top links)
instances.learn: Give each design principle its own tiny proof (cells for monospace, look-alike glyphs for differentiation) and keep the explanation to one paragraph beside it

reconstruction.layout: Two-column rows inside the 1000px column: specimen centred in the left half (~480px), text column ~400px from x≈770; '¶' at x≈270 between rows; rows ~260px apart
reconstruction.typography: Notes ~17px mononoki Regular, leading ~1.1, dark grey-green #586e75; drop caps 4 lines tall built from ASCII characters in orange #cb4b16; 'monospace' ~44px light on #586e75 cells; 'high'/'low' ~40px Regular/Bold; '|1lI B8 CD0O' ~40px grey-green; captions ~14px Italic; code ~16px with Solarized syntax colours (comment grey italic, keywords green, strings cyan, numbers magenta)
reconstruction.content: Real design notes: who made it and why, monospace as a structuring convention, surviving low-resolution grids, distinguishing similar characters
reconstruction.html: div.grid > div.box (div.example) + div.dropcap[aria-hidden] (ASCII art) + div.droptext; div.wingdings.span-all '¶' separators

instances.look: A centred italic orange note 'mononoki is a free font developed as a passion project in my spare time, but if you enjoy my work and would like to leave a tip, here is my → tip jar!'; the actual Download button is in the hero
instances.ux: Tip-jar link; download is a direct release ZIP from GitHub (hero button)
instances.learn: For a free font, a one-sentence tip-jar line placed after the arguments is enough

reconstruction.layout: Centred text block ~450px wide, 4 lines, between two '¶' separators
reconstruction.typography: ~15px mononoki Italic, orange; link in green with '→'
reconstruction.content: Donation request in the designer's voice

instances.look: 'All characters contained in mononoki' over a centred grid of every glyph (accented Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, numerals, punctuation, arrows, box-drawing and block elements, powerline shapes) in grey-green, ~32 per row
instances.learn: A coding font's set should end with the box-drawing and block characters: they are what terminal users check

reconstruction.layout: Grid ~1000px wide, ~32 columns of ~31px, ~22 rows at ~26px pitch; title centred above
reconstruction.content: Every character in the font, text rendered from the webfont
